name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck kitchen & ordering
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect your kitchen from too many orders, and keep serving when the signal disappears. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service from.

Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can make, and then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue fits the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add at-the-van orders on the same screen as the pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs making now, what is next, and what is ready, with an alarm when an order needs to get going.

PRINT TICKETS
Connect a receipt (ticket) printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or via your local network, and the tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DISAPPEARS
Switch on offline protection, and if the connection disappears, pre-ordering is paused so nobody places an order you don't see. Orders you take on the device are saved and synchronised when you are online again.

BUILT FOR THE VAN
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get notified when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Create your events and locations once, and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
